newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER SHOWCASE-LAZARONI SAYS FENERBAHCE SACKING HASTY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-LAZARONI SAYS FENERBAHCE SACKING HASTY.

text.p: Brazilian coach Sebastiao Lazaroni said on Friday he had been shocked by the Fenerbahce management's "hasty and over-emotional" move in sacking him following Wednesday night's defeat in a cup derby.
"As far as I'm concerned, Fenerbahce is successful," the state-run Anatolian news agency quoted Lazaroni as saying.
"I am leaving the team three points from the top of the league and in second place...I believe the decision (to sack me) was a decision taken with too much emotion and haste."
Fenerbahce are lying second behind Istanbul rivals Galatasaray in the Turkish league. The two teams meet in a crucial derby on Sunday.
Lazaroni pointed out that he was at the helm when Fenerbahce beat Manchester United at Old Trafford -- in a European champion's league match -- for the first time in 40 years of European competition.
He said it was also under his direction that Fenerbahce beat Istanbul rivals Galatasaray 4-0 on Galatasaray turf in October.
Lazaroni also blamed the high number of players called up to mandatory military service -- including international goalkeeper Rustu Recber -- injuries, and the three foreign players rule.
He said the team was also hindered because a large number of the players were shown cards during league games.

The sale of forward Bulent Uygun mid-season because of "over-emotional" behaviour in a match involving a former team mate and a well-publicised rift between club chairman Ali Sen and the soccer federation had not helped matters, he said.
Lazaroni said he was now open to offers from other Turkish clubs.
His sacking followed Fenerbahce's 2-1 defeat by Istanbul rivals Besiktas who were playing with 10 men.

Lazaroni was attacked for changes made to the previously championship-winning team and the lack of results since the new year which has seen Fenerbahce score only two league goals and draw against lowly Altay.
